note: clampMove finds the single moved index (first `next[k] !== prev[k]`) and clamps circularly across the midnight seam when there are >= 2 thumbs. hitWall is true ONLY when the raw proposed value strictly differs from the clamped result — a proposal that already lands exactly on the boundary (e.g. exactly MIN_GAP_MIN away) is a silent clamp, hitWall=false. Contrast the below-floor/above-ceiling/wrap-seam cases (hitWall true) against the exact-315 case (hitWall false).

cases.name: clampMove: below floor clamps up, hitWall true
clampMove: above ceiling (single thumb) clamps to DAY_MIN-SNAP_MIN, hitWall true
clampMove: wrap seam at i=0 clamps against the last thumb across midnight, hitWall true
clampMove: wrap seam at i=n-1 clamps against the first thumb across midnight, hitWall true
clampMove: exact MIN_GAP_MIN (315) away from neighbor is legal — silent clamp, hitWall false
canBookAt: t below floor -> forbidden zone [0, floor]
canBookAt: exact 315-minute gap from an existing reset is legal -> null
canBookAt: inside an existing reset's gap -> forbidden zone around it
